name: Payload Arsenal
title: Payload Arsenal — XSS, SQLi & SSTI Payloads
description: A categorised offensive payload reference for web application testing: cross-site scripting, SQL injection, SSTI, LFI and command injection payloads with bypass techniques, encoding tricks and the context each one is built for.

name: Regex Lab
title: Regex Lab — Test & Explain Regular Expressions
description: Write and test regular expressions in real time with a plain-English breakdown of every token, capture group and quantifier, plus catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS) detection on the patterns you run.

name: JWT / JOSE Inspector
title: JWT Decoder & Verifier — Inspect JWS and JWE
description: Decode and verify JSON Web Tokens entirely in your browser. Inspect JWS and JWE headers, claims and signatures, validate HMAC and RSA keys, and audit tokens for alg:none and other classic JWT flaws.

name: Certificate Studio
title: X.509 Certificate Studio — Generate & Inspect
description: Generate keys and X.509 certificates, build a signing chain, inspect TLS certificates and PEM/DER/PKCS#12 files, and construct mutual-TLS setups for lab environments — all locally, with nothing sent to a server.

name: Crypto Lab
title: Crypto Lab — Hashes, HMAC & AES Tools
description: A practical cryptography workbench: SHA and MD5 message digests, HMAC, AES encryption and decryption, base64 and hex encoding, and classical ciphers for CTF work and quick analysis.

name: CVSS Calculator
title: CVSS Calculator — v3.1 & v4.0 Scoring
description: Build a CVSS vector and get the base score with a breakdown of every metric. Covers exploitability and impact subscores, severity bands and the vector string to paste straight into a report.

name: Hash Identifier
title: Hash Identifier — Detect Hash Types
description: Paste a hash and identify its likely algorithm from length, character set and known prefixes. Every candidate includes a confidence rating, its hashcat mode and a ready-to-run cracking example.

name: HTTP Security Header Analyzer
title: HTTP Security Header Analyzer
description: Analyse HTTP response headers against modern security best practice and get an A–F grade. Checks Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, X-Frame-Options and others, explains the risk of each gap and gives the exact value to set.

name: Hex Dump Analyzer
title: Hex Dump Analyzer — Signatures & Entropy
description: Turn raw or copied hex into a readable xxd-style dump. Detect file signatures and magic bytes, measure Shannon entropy to spot packed or encrypted data, and extract printable strings from a binary.

name: Nmap Output Parser
title: Nmap Parser — Host & Service Summary
description: Paste nmap XML or grepable output to get a clean per-host summary of open ports, services, versions and findings, grouped and filterable for note-taking and reporting.

name: Recon Suite
title: Recon Suite — Subdomain & Domain Recon
description: A combined reconnaissance workbench: enumerate subdomains from a wordlist, resolve DNS records and flag the hosts worth investigating, then pivot into the rest of the toolset from one place.

name: Reverse Shell Generator
title: Reverse Shell Generator & TTY Upgrades
description: Generate reverse and bind shell payloads for bash, Python, PowerShell, netcat and more, with the matching listener command, shell stabilisation steps and CTF post-exploitation quick wins.

name: AI Prompt Injection Lab
title: AI Prompt Injection Lab
description: Practise and study prompt injection, system-prompt leakage and jailbreak techniques against LLM applications, organised by attack category with the defensive control that stops each one.

name: MDX Preview
title: MDX Preview
description: A writing surface for previewing MDX components and notes.
